substantive_new_information: Old unit20 screened without design/API because recoloring a grid route could create a competing marked path. This design instead adds four exact existing-vertex point markers; every black route edge and every gray grid edge keeps its original color/width. It supplies an explicit source-unit/receiver-run endpoint correspondence, not an alternate route.
mechanism_before_calls: Match start/end roles of one actual20cm square side with the two endpoints of the bottom60cm straight run. Targets treating a single uninterrupted endpoint-to-endpoint run as one unit, undercounting40cm and selecting A=380.

every_marker_role.role: Red source start: actual left end of one20cm horizontal smallest-square side on the black route.
Blue source end: actual right end of that20cm side.
Red receiver start: lower-left endpoint of the full60cm black bottom run.
Blue receiver end: lower-right endpoint of that60cm run.

annotation_semantics_lesson_applied: Numerical length question, not a point-count target. Four markers lie on actual existing square/path corners and do not introduce a new edge or route. Original black path remains continuous and distinguishable from gray grid; P,Q labels remain. Marked points are endpoint comparisons, not equal-length symbols or additional20cm givens.
